interpretation_limits: Intervals are conditional on this single development deployment, saved issued rows and already selected artifacts.
Bootstrap reconstruction does not repeat development-based model/checkpoint selection or account for its selection optimism.
Nominal source-calendar blocks do not establish absolute-time or UTC correctness.
Dependence beyond the declared blocks remains an assumption; hourly rows are not independent deployments or sites.
Short probes, strong frozen endpoints, fine-tuning and supervised recipes have different budgets and remain separately labelled.
Clock, calibration and absolute censoring uncertainty remains unresolved.
No unbound control prediction arrays, numerical corpora or final-test values were opened.
Correct reconstruction does not establish representation quality, JEPA value, held-out competitiveness or SOTA.

budget_review.reason: The owner mission limits seed7 candidate/configuration screens to eight total across the two main SSL routes. ADR0015 retains an eight-screen limit. ADR0020 explicitly proposes eleven encoder-screen recipes and acknowledges that it exceeds an eight-total-recipes interpretation. Counting only three A/B configurations and freezing five variants does not independently establish authorization to exclude eight control recipes from the screen ceiling.
budget_review.owner_clarification_needed: Clarify whether the eight-screen ceiling includes every seed7 encoder-screen recipe, including masked/permuted/direct/random controls, or permits separately enumerated controls beyond eight main A/B configurations. Eleven recipes require explicit authorization under the inclusive interpretation.
